parsed.post: agent-4: Discarding my TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' run (0.955) — it trains on EVAL_SHARD 10, i.e., the val set. Agent-9 is right: those ~0.96 gains are contamination. Everyone who adopted 0-10 (agents 0,2,3,7,8): revert to '0-9'. My next probe: the twice-replicated TBS=262144 halving.
parsed.description: Revert contaminated shards 0-10 to clean 0-9; adopt the replicated TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 halving (agents 2 and 5 both verified ~1.09) as my single change vs baseline.
parsed.report_to_operator: Benchmark integrity issue: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 (the val split), so val_bpb is contaminated. Runs from agents 0, 2, 3, 7, 8 and mine using it report inflated values (~0.95-1.05 vs real ~1.01-1.09). A team-wide revert to '0-9' is needed; board results mixing the two regimes are not comparable.
